Architecture & Specifications

Engineered for High-Pressure Scam Intervention

Real scam calls use extreme psychological isolation and threats of immediate imprisonment. Kavach is built to operate under real-world speakerphone acoustics, delivering interventions in milliseconds before financial compliance occurs.

Six Layers of Active Defense

Built from scratch around the practical reality of Indian elderly households.

Architecture

Second-Device Acoustic Room Capture

Kavach requires zero telecommunication carrier access or SIM-level wiretapping. An old tablet or spare smartphone sits on the living room table. When the elder puts an unknown caller on speakerphone, Kavach captures acoustic audio at 16 kHz PCM.

  • ✓Client-side energy VAD with local silence gating (0 credits wasted on silence)
  • ✓Resilient to ambient background noise (televisions, pressure cookers, traffic)
  • ✓Automatic disconnect after 3 minutes of continuous silence or 20 minutes maximum
Core Intelligence

Deterministic 5-Stage Scam State Machine

Scammers execute well-defined psychological extortion scripts. Rather than relying on slow, non-deterministic LLM chat completions, Kavach runs an offline, zero-I/O finite state machine that evaluates conversation context in 0.8 milliseconds.

S1 Authority
Authority Impersonation
Claims to be Mumbai Police, CBI, Customs, TRAI
S2 Accusation
Threat & Coercion
Arrest warrant, passport cancellation, contraband found
S3 Isolation
Isolation Mandate
Do not tell family, close room door, stay on Skype video
S4 Urgency
Manufactured Urgency
Immediate supreme court order, 20 minute compliance limit
S5 Payment
Financial Diversion
RBI verification account, RTGS clearing, liquidation of assets
Speed

Sub-Second Caregiver Dispatch

The moment stage S3 (Isolation) or S4 (Urgency) is detected, Kavach dispatches an emergency push notification to registered family caregivers over Telegram with the exact scam phrase, audio transcript excerpt, and 1-tap action buttons.

  • ✓Dispatched in under 650 ms end-to-end from utterance completion
  • ✓Includes 1-click action link: Intercom, Call Elder, or Mark False Alarm
  • ✓Direct cryptographic token authentication for caregiver security
Psychological Shield

Familial Voice Intervention (Consented Clone)

When an elder is trapped in high psychological panic, a generic electronic siren or robot voice is often ignored or silenced. Kavach plays a loud, pre-rendered alert in the verified voice of their actual son or daughter through the tabletop speaker.

  • ✓Strict DPDP liveness verification: 3-phrase random challenge during onboarding
  • ✓Voice embeddings can be deleted with 1-click at any time
  • ✓Offline pre-rendered audio clips ensure zero synthesis latency during active panic
Live Intervention

Caregiver Intercom (Push-to-Talk)

If a caregiver receives a Level 3 alert while away from home, they can immediately hold a push-to-talk button on their phone. Their live voice broadcasts directly out of the elder’s tabletop device to break the scammer’s spell.

  • ✓One-way priority audio override to tabletop tablet
  • ✓Instantly shatters the scammer’s illusion of secrecy and control
  • ✓Full acoustic audit logged for family verification
Compliance

Zero Raw Audio Storage & 7-Day Auto-Purge

Built strictly to the requirements of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP 2023). Kavach streams raw audio chunks in memory to the STT worker and discards them immediately upon transcription.

  • ✓Raw audio is never written to disk, database, or external object storage
  • ✓Transcript snippets are capped at 160 characters and auto-purged after 7 days
  • ✓Explicit trilingual elder consent notice displayed on the device
